title: Unit tests for element manipulation
description: Write automated unit tests to verify move, resize, and delete operations on canvas elements work correctly.

evidence: Created src/__tests__/element-manipulation.test.ts with 8 unit tests covering: table movement (updateTablePosition), table resizing (updateTable width/height), table deletion (removeTable with relationship cascade), and relationship deletion (removeRelationship).
Docker test run: node:20-alpine container, vitest v2.1.9, all hardening flags applied (--user, --tmpfs /tmp, --cap-drop ALL, --security-opt no-new-privileges, --rm, --init).
Test results: 29 test files passed, 365 tests passed, 0 failures. element-manipulation.test.ts: 8/8 passed.
